# Pixel Virtual Pet

A simple offline browser app featuring a CSS-drawn pixel creature with hunger, happiness, and energy bars. Use the Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons to interact with your pet and watch its mood change.

## Features

- Pixel art creature drawn with CSS
- Three stat bars: Hunger, Happiness, Energy
- Buttons to feed, play, and sleep
- Mood text updates based on stats
- Accessible: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, focus states
- Responsive down to 360px wide
- No external dependencies, fully offline

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Click or tap the buttons to interact with your pet.

## Files

- `index.html` – main markup
- `styles.css` – visual styling
- `script.js` – game logic
